finalText:
All 40 pass now.

**Root cause:** `computeTotal` round USD subtotal twice mid-calc (after percent cut, after flat cut) before final currency convert + round. Reference only round once, at very end. Rounding USD to cents early then multiplying by non-1.0 exchange rate (GBP 0.78, CAD 1.35, JPY 149) shifts final cent boundary — explains why only stacked-with-percent-coupon + non-USD orders drift, and why most carts look fine (USD rate=1 hide it, EUR sometimes lucky).

**Fix:** dropped both intermediate `round()` calls in `src/pricing/engine.js`, keep only the final round after currency conversion.
